name: @nexus-arc/studio-desktop
description: Nexus Studio standalone desktop application shell (Tauri 2)

scripts.build: npm run package-sidecar && tauri build --config src-tauri/binaries/tauri.bundle.conf.json
scripts.build:connected: npm run package-sidecar:connected && tauri build --config src-tauri/binaries/tauri.bundle.conf.json
scripts.build:full: npm run package-sidecar:full && tauri build --config src-tauri/binaries/tauri.bundle.conf.json
